ServicesEnabled.Description: Set true only after exactly one successful bootstrap container exit 0.

LiveSendEnabled.Description: True only with verified provider/account/destination qualification.

ProviderSecretArn.Description: Optional JSON secret with exact ZAVU_* runtime keys; required when live. Usable for read-only callbacks/reconciliation when live=false.

QueuePrefix.Description: Unique stable queue prefix; changing it replaces retained source queues.

AlarmTopicArn.Description: Existing monitored SNS topic; operators own subscriptions.

Assertions.AssertDescription: Live sending requires a qualified provider JSON secret.
